content_zh:
“哎呀，你快把手洗了！找揍呢！”老婶被自己孙子喊得受不了，过来把水龙头啊！”
“我没打过他。”程博衍走到一边，拿了个盘子准备装鸡腿。
“那反正也没少骂没少凶，”老婶皱着眉，“博衍，就你这脾气，将来自己要有个孩子，你打算怎么揍啊？”
程博衍笑了笑没出声。
“他不要孩子！谁说他要孩子了！”奶奶瞪了老婶一眼。
老婶有些尴尬地扯着程炫宇去客厅了。
“过年有安排吗？”奶奶把炸好的鸡腿码到盘子里。
“什么安排？”程博衍愣了愣，从暖水壶里倒了杯水喝着，“值班？”
“哎，怎么跟你爸一样啊，问什么都想着医院啊，我是问你过年的安排啊，”奶奶看着他，“你都快三十了，就算是男朋友，也该带一个回来吧？”
程博衍呛了一口水：“您怎么还操心这个啊！”
项西没有回大洼里，这阵子他跟馒头都住在大健那儿。
马上过年了，每年这个时候平叔的老娘还有媳妇、孩子都会回来，平叔的儿子在隔壁市里念高中，听说成绩还不错，老娘、媳妇都陪着儿子在那边，过年了就会一块儿回到大洼里。
这种时候像项西这种作为平叔不是好玩意的标志而存在的人，就不合适还待在那儿了。
大健是二盘的死忠粉，属于二盘所到之处他都得举着花上跟前欢呼去的那种，二盘跟平叔又拴一块儿，让项西和馒头待在他那儿，平叔很放心。
其实过年项西也不太愿意待在大洼里。
那里平时虽然乱七八糟，满眼看去没一个正常活着的人，但起码还有人气，过年租客们一走，别说是大洼里，就连带赵家窑那一片，都会突然变得空荡荡的，一片破败。
瘆得慌。
“今儿送你过来的那人是谁？”大健叼着烟躺在床上问项西。
“一个人。”项西坐在沙发上，怎么坐都不舒服，这破沙发下面的弹簧高低纵横，他始终没找到合适的凹陷来放屁股，再扭几下又怕弹簧会破土而出，最后他站起来，在旁边的木凳子上坐下了。
“还开辆挺好的车，”大健看着他，“你什么时候认识这样的人了？”

项西看了大健一眼，没说话，什么好车，在大健眼里，大概只要不是电瓶车，都算好车了。
“你……”大健还想再说什么，不过没说完。
项西直接起身甩门出去了。
在门外点了一根烟，馒头颠着跟了出来，项西看了馒头一眼，把烟递到了他面前。
“何必呢，”馒头接过烟叼上，“住大健这儿呢，他问两句就问两句呗，没准是平叔让他注意的呢？”
“大健算个屁，”项西又拿了一根烟点上，喷出一口烟，“我没那闲工夫分析他想干什么，平叔想知道自己会问，轮得上他舔腚吗？”
这种暗无天日的生活里，这是项西展示自己脾气的唯一途径。
他是平叔养大的，他只给平叔面子，只买平叔的账，除了平叔，谁在他跟前都是个不带响的屁。
心情不爽了他还能拉个大长脸给平叔看呢。
这是他最后的挣扎，证明自己没被黑暗吃透吸干的方式。
“我的意思是，这帮人平时没人敢这么问你，他敢问肯定是平叔点了头的……”馒头皱着眉。
“平叔看我不顺眼也不是一天两天了。”项西用牙咬着烟抬头看了看天，黑漆漆的，没有星星更没月亮，又要下雪。
“小展，你最近到底是怎么了啊？”馒头叹口气蹲到地上。
“我叛逆期到了，文盲。”项西回答。
“你不文盲，你认识的字还没我多呢！”馒头又叹了口气，“我就觉得不踏实，总觉得要出事，二盘敢动你，我觉得就不是个好……”
“你都要私奔的人了，操心你自己吧，管这么多也不怕小瘸腿扛不住。”项西低头冲馒头脑袋顶上吐了一口烟。
“这可是你自己提的啊！”馒头立马指着他喊。
“我提的，怎么着，”项西笑笑，转身往屋里走，声音很低地说了一句，“我就看你怎么找死呢。”
回了屋，大健已经躺在床上了，抱着部手机不知道跟哪个女的起腻。

content_en:
"Oh, wash your hands! You're looking for a beating!" The old aunt couldn't bear the shouting of her grandson, so she came over and turned on the faucet! "
"I didn't hit him. "Cheng Boyan walked aside and took a plate to put the chicken legs on.
"Then you're scolding me a lot anyway," the old aunt frowned, "Bo Yan, with your temper, if you have a child in the future, how are you going to beat him up? "
Cheng Boyan smiled and said nothing.
"He doesn't want children! Who said he wanted a child! "Grandma glared at the old aunt.
The old aunt dragged Cheng Xuanyu to the living room with some embarrassment.
"Do you have any plans for the New Year? "Grandma put the fried chicken legs on the plate.
"What arrangement? Cheng Boyan was stunned for a moment, poured a glass of water from the thermos and drank, "On duty?" "
"Hey, why are you like your dad? He always thinks about the hospital when asking questions. I'm asking about your New Year arrangements." Grandma looked at him, "You are almost thirty, even if you are a boyfriend, you should bring one back, right? "
Cheng Boyan took a sip of water: "Why do you still worry about this! "
Xiang west didn't go back to Dawali. He and Mantou were staying at Dajian's place these days.
The Chinese New Year is coming soon. Every year at this time, Uncle Ping’s mother, daughter-in-law, and children will come back. Uncle Ping’s son is studying in high school in the city next door. I heard that his grades are not bad. My mother and daughter-in-law are accompanying her son there, and they will return to Dawali together after the Chinese New Year.
At this time, people like Xiang west, who exist as a sign that Uncle Ping is not a toy, are not suitable to stay there.
Da Jian is a die-hard fan of Er Pan. He is the kind of person who has to hold flowers and cheer in front of Er Pan wherever he goes. Er Pan is tied to Uncle Ping and lets Xiang west and Mantou stay at his place. Uncle Ping is very relieved.
In fact, Xiang west is not willing to stay in Dawali during the Chinese New Year.
Although the place is usually a mess, with no normal living person in sight, at least it is still popular. Once the tenants leave during the New Year, not to mention Dawali, even the Zhaojiayao area will suddenly become empty and dilapidated.
Terrified.
"Who is the person who sent you here today? "Da Jian asked Xiang west while lying on the bed with a cigarette in his mouth.
"A person. "Xiang Xi sat on the sofa. It was uncomfortable no matter how he sat. The springs under the broken sofa were high and low. He could never find a suitable depression to put his butt. If he twisted it a few times, he was afraid that the spring would break out of the ground. Finally, he stood up and sat down on the wooden stool next to him.
"And he drives a pretty good car," Da Jian looked at him, "Since when did you know such a person? "
Xiang west glanced at Dajian and said nothing. In Dajian's eyes, any good car is considered a good car as long as it is not a battery car.
"You..." Da Jian wanted to say something more, but he didn't finish.
Xiang west stood up and slammed the door and walked out.
He lit a cigarette outside the door, and the steamed bun followed him out. Xiang west glanced at the steamed bun and handed the cigarette to him.
"Why bother," Steamed Bun took the cigarette and put it in his mouth, "I live here in Dajian. He can just ask a few questions. Maybe Uncle Ping asked him to pay attention to it?" "
"Dajian is nothing," Xiang Xi lit up another cigarette and blew out a puff of smoke, "I don't have the time to analyze what he wants to do. Uncle Ping wondered what he would ask, is it his turn to lick his ass? "
In this dark life, this is the only way for Xiang west to show his temper.
He was raised by Uncle Ping. He only gave Uncle Ping face and only paid for Uncle Ping. Except for Uncle Ping, everyone in front of him was a silent fart.
When he was upset, he could still show Uncle Ping a long face.
This was his last struggle, a way to prove that he had not been eaten up and sucked dry by the darkness.
"I mean, no one in this group of people would dare to ask you that. If he dares to ask, Uncle Ping must have nodded..." Mantou frowned.
"Uncle Ping has been displeased with me for more than a day or two. "Xiang west held the cigarette between his teeth and looked up at the sky. It was dark, with no stars or moon, and it was going to snow again.
"Xiao Zhan,What's happened to you recently? "Steamed Bun sighed and squatted on the ground.
“I have reached my rebellious stage and am illiterate. "Xiang west replied.
“You are not illiterate, and you don’t know as many words as I do! "Mantou sighed again, "I just don't feel at ease. I always feel that something is going to happen. If I dare to touch you in the second set, I don't think it's a good idea..."
"You are going to be the one to elope. Just worry about yourself. You don't have to worry about the little lame being unable to handle it. "Xiang west lowered his head and blew out a puff of smoke on the top of the bun's head.
"You brought this up yourself! "Steamed Bun immediately pointed at him and shouted.
"I mentioned it, what's the matter?" Xiang west smiled, turned around and walked into the house, saying in a low voice, "I just want to see how you want to die. "
After returning to the house, Dajian was already lying on the bed, holding a mobile phone and not knowing which girl he was getting tired of.
